compatibility.detail: Roborock's English Qrevo S5V manual identifies robot model RRW0PEP. Check the app or underside label if your unit says Qrevo S, Pro, MaxV, Curv or Edge instead.
The S5V uses two short, parallel rollers with spiral blades. Roborock sells this brush for the S5V; a single full-width Qrevo S roller is a different design.
The washable filter fits the robot dustbin. The disposable 2.7 L E12-rated bag fits the multifunctional dock. They are separate parts and cannot be substituted for one another.

Roborock lists some individual filters and brush parts for several models, including the S5V, Curv and Edge. That shared listing does not confirm that every part in a multi-model kit fits all of them.

careTip: Switch off the robot before maintenance. Rinse the washable filter with clean water only and leave it to air-dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling. Keep a disposable dust bag installed whenever the dock auto-empties.

questions.question: Will a Qrevo S replacement brush fit the Qrevo S5V?
questions.answer: Do not assume so. The S5V uses Roborock's DuoDivide split-roller brush. The original Qrevo S uses a different full-width roller. Use a listing that names Qrevo S5V and shows the DuoDivide brush.

questions.question: How often should I replace Qrevo S5V filters and brushes?
questions.answer: Roborock recommends replacing the washable robot filter and main brushes every 6–12 months, and the side brush every 3–6 months. Clean the filter and main brush every 2 weeks and the side brush monthly.

questions.question: Which dust bag does the Qrevo S5V dock use?
questions.answer: Roborock describes a 2.7 L E12-rated disposable dock bag and says its capacity can cover up to 7 weeks of use. The linked third-party pack is labeled 2.7 L and names Qrevo S5V; check both details on the selected listing.

questions.question: Are these all genuine Roborock parts?
questions.answer: The linked DuoDivide main brush and side brushes are Roborock-branded originals. The filters, bags and mop cloths are third-party products; their compatibility comes from their Amazon sellers and has not been fit-tested by DustMigo.
